artists.biography: Angine de Poitrine is a Canadian rock duo formed in Saguenay, Quebec, in 2019. Its anonymous members perform under the pseudonyms Khn de Poitrine and Klek de Poitrine (drums). They are known for complex microtonal compositions in the style of math rock and experimental rock, and an absurdist image, with oversized papier-mâché masks and black-and-white polka-dotted costumes.

Angine De Poitrine.biography: Angine de Poitrine is a Canadian rock duo formed in Saguenay, Quebec, in 2019. Its anonymous members perform under the pseudonyms Khn de Poitrine and Klek de Poitrine (drums). They are known for complex microtonal compositions in the style of math rock and experimental rock, and an absurdist image, with oversized papier-mâché masks and black-and-white polka-dotted costumes.

perplexity.description:
Vol.1 is the debut album by Angine de Poitrine, a rock-oriented release that blends prog rock, psychedelic textures, and adventurous rhythmic interplay. The record centers on driving drum grooves and intricately layered microtonal guitars, creating a hypnotic, almost ritualistic sound that draws on both experimental rock and the band’s own playful, dada-like identity.

Originally issued in 2024, Vol.1 was later re-released on CD and black vinyl by Spectacles Bonzaï, bringing the album to a wider audience after a period of self-distribution. The six-track set—featuring pieces such as “Sherpa,” “Tohogd,” and “L’Aberek”—runs just over 32 minutes and has been described as expansive yet tightly focused, with a sound that recalls Anatolian rock at its most animated while remaining distinctly eccentric and modern.
